name: Polaris
fit: Commerce admin, checkout, and point of sale.
principles: One UI framework, built on web components, shared by Shopify admin, checkout, customer accounts, and Point of Sale. Each surface exposes its own subset of components.
components: Web components for admin, checkout, customer accounts, and Point of Sale. A surface does not get the full set.
adapt: Keep the idea of one commerce framework with a smaller set per surface. Open the source before using a color, type size, space, or shadow. Replace Shopify's brand.
